verdict: Maybe. It's a fun hook that got Girgit a deal on Shark Tank India Season 2, but novelty wears off. Colour-changing clothes work best for kids, gifts and events. Plan for new designs regularly and check that the special inks survive washing before you scale.
angle: Heat- and UV-reactive inks make T-shirts change colour with sunlight or touch, which appeals to children and gift buyers. The key risks are durability after washing and the product being seen as a one-time novelty. Test wash durability carefully and consider school, event and corporate orders.
